explanation: The theorem reduces the library's own Deligne theorem statement (about Tannakian fibre functors, moderate growth and so on) to a small-category model. It is built entirely from this library's own definitions: DeligneTheoremStatement, SmallDeligne, TensorGeneratedBy and ModerateLengthGrowth. I grepped Mathlib for Deligne, TensorGeneratedBy and FibreFunctor. The hits were unrelated (T-structures, Galois fibre functors, Mellin/zeta references). I found no Mathlib declaration of Deligne's theorem or of this reduction.
